units.gdp: cumulative GDP growth error percentage points relative to fold-origin GDP

selectionRule: For each outcome compute each candidate's MAE separately in cells 2016→2017, 2016→2018, 2017→2018, then average the three cell MAEs with equal cell weight. Use ladder error in points and GDP error 100*(predicted-actual)/fold-origin-GDP in percentage points. From candidates within 1% of the smallest score (plus absolute 1e-12 for floating point), choose largest persistence weight, then smallest score, then earliest registered grid index. If a cell is empty, throw instead of changing weights or folds.
limitations: Only two origins and horizons 1–2 can be checked. Countries and targets repeat across cells; this is temporal validation for the same countries, not independent-country evidence. No observed seven-year validation is available inside four years. Candidate selection itself is optimistic.

ladder.selectionLoss: equal mean of three cell MAEs

gdp.selectionLoss: equal mean of three cell MAEs
